title: Le Combalou, Roquefort-sur-Soulzon
author: unknown
desc_zh: 孔巴卢山崖：罗克福尔奶酪的熟成洞就开凿在这片坍塌的石灰岩山体里。
desc_en: Le Combalou, the collapsed limestone massif into which Roquefort's aging caves are dug.

title: Wikicheese - Roquefort
author: unknown
desc_zh: 石板上的一块罗克福尔羊奶蓝纹奶酪。
desc_en: A wedge of Roquefort, the ewe's-milk blue, on slate.

title: Wikicheese - Brie de Meaux
author: unknown
desc_zh: 莫城布里奶酪的白霉外皮特写。
desc_en: Close-up of the bloomy rind of Brie de Meaux.

title: Munster cheese
author: unknown
desc_zh: 阿尔萨斯芒斯特洗皮奶酪，橙色外皮。
desc_en: Munster, the orange-rinded washed-rind cheese of Alsace.

title: Still Life with Cheeses, Artichoke, and Cherries (c. 1625), Clara Peeters, LACMA
author: Clara Peeters
desc_zh: 克拉拉·彼得斯《奶酪、洋蓟与樱桃静物》（约 1625 年，洛杉矶郡立美术馆藏）。
desc_en: Clara Peeters, Still Life with Cheeses, Artichoke, and Cherries (c. 1625), LACMA.

title: Tibetan butter tea
author: unknown
desc_zh: 一碗藏式酥油茶：茶、盐与酥油打制而成。
desc_en: A bowl of Tibetan butter tea, churned from tea, salt and butter.

title: Monk churning butter tea
author: unknown
desc_zh: 僧人用长筒打茶桶（酥油茶桶）打制酥油茶。
desc_en: A monk churning butter tea in a tall wooden churn.

title: Chhurpi
author: unknown
desc_zh: 楚尔皮（chhurpi）：喜马拉雅东部的硬质干奶酪，可以含在嘴里慢慢嚼数小时。
desc_en: Chhurpi, a hard dried cheese of the eastern Himalayas, chewed slowly for hours.

title: Kurut drying, Kyrgyzstan
author: unknown
desc_zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦晾晒中的库鲁特（qurut）：酸奶 / 乳清凝块搓成小球后风干。
desc_en: Kurut (qurut) drying in Kyrgyzstan: balls of strained soured milk left to dry.

title: Kefir grains
author: unknown
desc_zh: 克菲尔粒：细菌与酵母共生形成的胶质颗粒，放进牛奶就能发酵出克菲尔。
desc_en: Kefir grains — a gelatinous colony of bacteria and yeasts that ferments milk into kefir.

title: Rushan being grilled, Dali, Yunnan
author: unknown
desc_zh: 云南大理街头，摊主在炭火上烤乳扇——薄片状的牛乳制品。
desc_en: A vendor in Dali, Yunnan, grilling rushan, thin sheets of dried milk curd.

title: Yunnan woman with yak cheese
author: unknown
desc_zh: 云南高原上一位妇女捧着牦牛奶酪。
desc_en: A woman in highland Yunnan holding a yak cheese.
note: 竖幅；人物肖像，使用时注意语境

title: Labneh
author: unknown
desc_zh: 一碗拉布内（labneh）浓缩酸奶奶酪，配果酱。
desc_en: A bowl of labneh, strained yogurt cheese, with jam.

title: Labneh with olive oil
author: unknown
desc_zh: 浸在橄榄油里的拉布内。
desc_en: Labneh in olive oil.

title: Homemade airag in Mongolia
author: unknown
desc_zh: 蒙古牧民家自酿的马奶酒（airag）：从蓝色塑料桶里舀出一杯。
desc_en: Homemade airag (fermented mare's milk) in Mongolia, poured from a plastic barrel.

title: Airag (kumis) of Mongolia
author: unknown
desc_zh: 蒙古马奶酒（airag / 忽迷思）盛在彩绘瓷缸里。
desc_en: Mongolian airag (kumis) served from a painted porcelain bowl.

title: Vat of curds and whey
author: Jesse Gillies
desc_zh: 不锈钢槽里，凝乳与乳清已经分开，工人用工具搅动凝乳粒。
desc_en: A vat where curds have separated from the whey, being stirred by cheesemakers.

title: Cutting Cheddar curds after setting
author: James.folsom at English Wikipedia
desc_zh: 切达奶酪制作：凝乳凝固后用切割器（curd knife / harp）切成小块。
desc_en: Cheddar making: cutting the set curd into small pieces with a curd knife.
